title: Support Analyst
content: Resolved complex client issues, improving satisfaction and enhancing internal knowledge base.
Liaised between Customer Experience and Engineering teams, translating complex technical issues into actionable solutions.
Supported proprietary train software (Luminate on Docker, Train Movement Viewer on AWS), ensuring system reliability and uptime.
Analysed train data across multiple systems to identify root causes of operational issues, reducing incident resolution time.

title: SME Support Engineer
content: Led migration of call data for a major bank from Nice NIM systems to Verint 15.2 WFO, ensuring data integrity and minimal downtime.
Designed SQL scripts to consolidate and normalise multi-source CDR data, enabling smooth Verint import.
Automated retrieval of call recordings from EMC Centera using PowerShell, reducing manual workload and improving efficiency.

title: IT Engineer
content: Provided technical support for voice recording solutions (Cisco, Mitel, Cloud9, Motorola) across active, passive, and VOX-based setups.
Managed Kubernetes-deployed microservices, optimising system resilience and uptime.
Built Python automation tools for system health checks and Slack integration, saving ~20 hours/week of manual work.
Supported compliance-driven clients, ensuring GDPR and internal audit adherence.

title: Systems Engineer
content: Supported and troubleshooted server infrastructure, VMware hypervisors, cloud environments (AWS, Azure), firewalls, VPNs, databases, web servers, and load balancers.
Assisted clients with Windows/Linux server administration and cloud infrastructure management.

title: IT Analyst
content: Provided IT support to ~300 head office staff and 50 remote locations.
Managed device configuration, software updates, and technical preparations for executive events.

title: Project Engineer
content: Modernised Rolls-Royce manufacturing PCs via SCCM, integrating proprietary software with existing systems.
Rescued an out-of-scope machine bay, preventing £1.4m in potential lost revenue.

title: IT Support Technician
content: Delivered IT support for 50+ SMB clients across the East Midlands.
Managed Office 365, WordPress sites, NAS, network equipment, and phone systems.
